title: 2K Indoor Wi-Fi Security Camera, Pan and Tilt, Night Vision, EU Plug
description:
A compact indoor camera that turns 355° side to side and 90° up and down, so one camera can watch a whole room from your phone. Handy for keeping an eye on pets, a playroom or an empty home.
• 2K (2304 × 1296) video with infrared night vision up to 10 m
• Motion and sound alerts with person detection, sent to the free app
• Two-way audio through the built-in microphone and speaker
• Saves clips to a microSD card (up to 256 GB, not included) or optional cloud storage
• 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; USB power adapter with EU plug and 3 m cable included

title: Outdoor Wi-Fi Bullet Camera 2K, IP66 Weatherproof, Colour Night Vision
description:
A weatherproof outdoor camera for driveways, gardens and entrances, with built-in spotlights that switch on to record colour video after dark.
• 2K resolution, 105° viewing angle, colour night vision up to 30 m
• IP66 rated against rain and dust, works from -20 °C to 50 °C
• Motion zones and instant phone alerts; spotlight and siren can be set off remotely
• Records to a microSD card (up to 256 GB, not included) or optional cloud storage
• 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi or Ethernet; 12 V power adapter with EU plug included

title: Wireless Battery Security Camera with Solar Panel, 2K, IP65
description:
A cable-free outdoor camera powered by a rechargeable battery that the included solar panel keeps topped up, so you can mount it anywhere within Wi-Fi range.
• 2K video, 130° wide angle, infrared and colour night vision
• Built-in 7800 mAh battery plus 3 W solar panel with 3 m cable
• PIR motion sensor reduces false alerts from moving shadows
• IP65 weatherproof, with two-way talk and a built-in siren
• microSD storage (card not included) or optional cloud plan; wall mount and screws included

title: 4-Camera Wireless Security System with 10-Channel NVR and 1 TB Drive
description:
A complete CCTV kit for a home or small shop: four weatherproof cameras link wirelessly to a recorder that stores footage around the clock on its built-in hard drive.
• 4 × 3 MP bullet cameras, IP66, night vision up to 25 m
• 10-channel NVR with a 1 TB hard drive pre-installed for continuous recording
• Live view and playback in the free app, or on a TV or monitor via HDMI
• Cameras connect over their own wireless network; each needs a nearby socket for power
• Includes 4 camera adapters and 1 NVR adapter (EU plug), mouse, network cable and screws

title: Wireless Video Doorbell 2K with Plug-In Chime, Battery Powered
description:
See and speak to whoever is at your door from your phone, wherever you are. The rechargeable battery means no wiring, and the plug-in chime rings inside the house.
• 2K HD video with a 166° head-to-toe view and infrared night vision
• Instant alerts when someone presses the button or motion is detected
• Two-way audio with noise reduction and quick-reply voice messages
• 6000 mAh rechargeable battery, up to 4 months per charge depending on use
• Plug-in chime with EU plug and 52 tones; IP65 weatherproof; mounting kit included

title: Wireless Doorbell Kit, Waterproof Button and Plug-In Chime, EU Plug
description:
A simple wireless doorbell with no wiring: plug the chime into any socket and fix the button by the door.
• Range up to 300 m in open space
• 58 melodies and 5 volume levels, with LED flash
• IP55 waterproof button with adhesive pad and screws
• Button battery included; chime has an EU plug

title: Smart Wi-Fi Plug with Energy Monitoring, 16 A, EU Plug, 4-Pack
description:
Switch lamps, heaters and other appliances on and off from your phone, with schedules and timers, and see how much electricity each one uses.
• Set of 4 Wi-Fi smart plugs, max load 16 A / 3680 W
• Live power reading plus daily, weekly and monthly energy history
• Schedules, countdown timers and away mode in the free app
• Voice control through common voice assistants; no hub required
• 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; EU plug (type F) with child protection shutters

title: Smart Power Strip with 4 Sockets and 3 USB Ports, Wi-Fi, EU Plug
description:
A Wi-Fi power strip where each socket can be switched on its own from the app, plus USB ports for charging phones and tablets.
• 4 individually controlled sockets plus 2 × USB-A and 1 × USB-C (20 W)
• Schedules and timers for each socket; manual buttons on the strip too
• Surge protection and overload switch
• Max 16 A / 3680 W in total; 1.5 m cable with EU plug (type F)

title: Smart Wi-Fi Light Switch, Touch Glass Panel, No Neutral Wire Needed
description:
Replaces a standard wall switch with a sleek touch panel you can also control from your phone, for example to have the lights on when you get home.
• Tempered glass touch panel with LED indicator, fits standard EU 86 × 86 mm wall boxes
• Works without a neutral wire, max 300 W per gang
• App control, schedules and voice control through common voice assistants
• Remembers its on/off state after a power cut
• Must be installed by a qualified electrician; screws included

title: Smart LED Bulb E27, 9 W, Colour and Tunable White, 4-Pack
description:
Screw in these Wi-Fi bulbs to change brightness, colour and warmth from your phone, set wake-up routines or match the light to a film night.
• 4 × E27 bulbs, 9 W (replaces 60 W), 806 lumens each
• 16 million colours plus white from 2700 K warm to 6500 K cool
• Schedules, scenes and music sync in the free app; no hub needed
• Works with common voice assistants
• Rated life around 25,000 hours; 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi

title: Smart RGB LED Strip Lights 10 m with App, Remote and Music Sync, EU Plug
description:
Self-adhesive colour-changing LED strips for behind the TV, under the bed or along shelves, controlled from your phone or the included remote.
• 10 m in total (2 × 5 m) with 300 RGB LEDs, can be cut every 3 LEDs
• Built-in microphone syncs the colours to music
• App with schedules, scenes and timer, plus a 24-key remote
• Strong self-adhesive backing; extra mounting clips included
• 12 V power adapter with EU plug included

title: Smart Bedside Table Lamp, RGB and Warm White, Touch and App Control
description:
A bedside lamp with a soft, even glow in any colour, controlled with a tap on top, from your phone or by voice.
• Warm to cool white plus 16 million colours, dimmable from 1 to 100 %
• Touch-sensitive top: tap to switch on or off, hold to dim
• App schedules with gentle sunrise wake-up and sunset fade
• USB-C powered; 1.5 m cable and USB power adapter with EU plug included
• Height 25 cm, base diameter 12 cm

title: Smart LED Bulb E27, Dimmable Warm to Cool White, 2-Pack
description:
Budget-friendly smart bulbs for everyday rooms: adjust brightness and colour temperature from your phone, or set them to switch on at dusk.
• 2 × E27 bulbs, 9 W (replaces 60 W), 806 lumens each
• Tunable white from 2700 K to 6500 K, dimmable from 1 to 100 %
• Schedules, timers and group control in the free app
• 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, no hub required; works with common voice assistants

title: Fingerprint Padlock, Keyless, USB-C Rechargeable, Splash-Proof
description:
Open your gym locker, bike shed or suitcase with a touch of your finger, with no keys or codes to remember.
• Stores up to 20 fingerprints and unlocks in about 0.5 seconds
• Zinc alloy body with stainless steel shackle
• Around 6 months of normal use per charge; charges via USB-C (cable included)
• IP65 splash-proof for outdoor use
• Shackle diameter 6 mm, inside clearance 24 mm

title: Smart Door Lock with Fingerprint, Keypad and Handle, for Interior Doors
description:
Replaces a standard door handle with a lock that opens by fingerprint, code, app or key, ideal for home offices, rented rooms and back doors.
• 5 ways to unlock: fingerprint (up to 100), PIN code, app, key card and mechanical key
• Fits doors 35–55 mm thick; reversible handle for left- or right-opening doors
• Runs on 4 × AA batteries (included) with low-battery warning and USB-C emergency power
• Temporary guest codes and an unlock history in the app
• Zinc alloy body; drilling template and screws included

title: Wi-Fi Motion Sensor, PIR, Battery Powered, Instant App Alerts
description:
A small battery-powered motion sensor that sends a phone notification when someone walks past, or switches on your smart lights automatically.
• Detection range up to 7 m with a 110° angle
• Runs on a CR123A battery (included) for up to 1 year
• Connects directly to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, no hub needed
• Triggers automations with other devices in the same app
• Free-standing base and adhesive pad included

title: Wi-Fi Temperature and Humidity Sensor with LCD Display
description:
Keep track of the climate in a nursery, cellar, greenhouse or wine store, with readings on the screen and history in the app.
• Measures -10 °C to 60 °C (±0.5 °C) and 0–99 % humidity (±3 %)
• Clear LCD display with comfort indicator
• App graphs and alerts when readings go above or below your limits
• Runs on 2 × AAA batteries (included); 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
• Stand and wall hook included; size 6 × 6 × 2 cm

title: Wireless Home Alarm Kit with Siren, Door Sensors and Motion Detector
description:
A DIY alarm kit for doors, windows and hallways that sounds a loud siren and alerts your phone if anything is triggered while you are away.
• Kit: Wi-Fi hub with built-in 110 dB siren, 4 door/window sensors, 1 motion detector and 2 remote key fobs
• Arm, disarm and home modes from the app or the key fobs
• Add up to 50 extra wireless sensors
• Backup battery keeps the hub running during short power cuts
• Hub power adapter with EU plug included; sensors run on included batteries

title: Smart Wi-Fi Speaker with 360° Sound, Bluetooth and Voice Control
description:
A compact speaker that fills the room with 360° sound and streams music over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, with far-field microphones for hands-free voice control.
• 15 W full-range driver with passive bass radiator
• Wi-Fi and Bluetooth 5.2; group several speakers for multi-room audio
• Far-field microphones with a mute button; works with common voice assistants
• Alarm, timer and sleep functions in the app
• Power adapter with EU plug included; size 10 × 10 × 14 cm

title: 10.1-Inch Wi-Fi Digital Photo Frame with Touchscreen, 32 GB
description:
Family and friends can send photos and short videos to this frame from anywhere using the free app, so new pictures appear straight on your shelf.
• 10.1-inch IPS touchscreen, 1280 × 800 resolution
• 32 GB built-in storage plus microSD and USB slots
• Auto-rotates portrait and landscape photos; slideshow, clock and weather screens
• Sleep schedule switches the screen off at night
• Power adapter with EU plug included; stands on a table or hangs on the wall
